new_value: Implemented in rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs + lib.rs re-exports (landed commit 15386220f4): (1) OriginSequenceTracker — per-origin monotonic u64 gate, capacity-bounded (default 256), touch-ordered least-recently-accepted eviction, zero-capacity fail-closed, mirrors python OriginSequenceTracker; (2) origin_addr_from_pubkey — upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey of raw pubkey bytes, ungated (no schnorr coupling); (3) sign_sos_origin_for_key — TX against the AddrForKey origin; (4) verify_sos_origin_gated — Schnorr48 verify first, gate accept only after verify (forgery never advances the gate).
